config.scoring_policy: structural validity gates scoring; cross-field diagnostic consistency reported separately without repair

base_lineage_verification.verification_timing: Full original weight hashes verified after training against the preexisting frozen base manifest; training metadata remains unchanged

adaptation.merge_arithmetic: FP32(B @ A) * alpha/r + FP32(original BF16 weight), then cast to original BF16

retry_invocations.seed_strategy: Ordinal 0 uses the frozen base seed. Ordinal >=1 uses the first 16 hex digits of SHA256('judge-bench-retry-v1:' + base_seed + ':' + item_id + ':' + ordinal), modulo 2147483647; increment modulo 2147483647 on collision with any prior seed. Ordinal counts every persisted HTTP attempt for that item across invocations.
retry_invocations.retry_signal: Only JSON/schema/API response shape and transient HTTP/transport errors; no gold labels or semantic inconsistency checks.
retry_invocations.legacy_attempt_seed: Attempts without an explicit seed in raw records used the frozen config seed.

performance.accounting: Usage and request counts cover every persisted HTTP attempt; per-request/item latency is neither measured nor recorded.
performance.reasoning_tokens_note: Reasoning tokens are zero if the serving API does not report a separate count.
